authority_scope: DWC project continuity only; does not select Multiversal software-roadmap work

execution_frontier.name: Inference-only R1 acoustic-reset hybrid diagnosis
execution_frontier.summary: R1 completed 128 batches but failed the governed gate 104/125. The repaired unique-identity acceptance rerun reproduced that result exactly. Five seed schedules produced only 100-107 passes; 75/125 rows are seed-sensitive and none fail all five. Removing duration noise improves a single seed to 112/125, but removing latent noise yields 0/125 and reduced latent noise yields 61/125. Default failure is 28% outside the 128-row R1 selection versus 9.3% inside it. Before any further training, compare R1 as-is against hybrids that restore the pristine warm-start decoder and/or flow while retaining the learned DWC text side.

seed_robustness.rule: A lucky seed is not promotable acceptance evidence.

noise_ablation.interpretation: Inference tuning alone is insufficient; output amplitude is strongly latent-noise dependent.

coverage_diagnosis.interpretation: The 128-row phone-balanced warm-up generalizes incompletely to natural/other acceptance rows.

probe_diagnosis.future_guard_requirement: Add row-level/quantile robustness protection; median-only amplitude guard is insufficient.

piper_transfer_boundary.r1_behavior: Custom R1 optimizer updated all model_g parameters, including the warm-start acoustic modules.
piper_transfer_boundary.diagnostic_hypothesis: Restore warm-start decoder and/or flow while retaining R1 DWC text-side weights to isolate acoustic-backbone drift from incomplete text/prior adaptation.

settled_architecture.frontend: DWC/PSS/CNS to engine-independent exact custom phoneme IDs; no English G2P at acoustic boundary

variants: restore full warm acoustic set dec+enc_q+flow
next_safe_execution.decision_after: If an acoustic-reset hybrid materially improves multi-seed robustness, design a protected retrain that preserves the successful warm-start acoustic modules. Otherwise diagnose/extend DWC text/prior generalization before any R2.

prohibited_forward_paths: enter R2 before a genuine governed R1 pass
resume or extend training before the acoustic-reset hybrid diagnosis is reviewed
select a lucky seed as acceptance
treat machine waveform acceptance as human CNS perceptual acceptance
